about: React Native's ActivityIndicator on OxyOS (issue #559; progress-bar.h): Android's AndroidProgressBar, drawn by the host as AOSP's indeterminate ring, on the UI thread (sample/ProgressProbe.tsx, the screen reader on in Spanish). Its rings held at 666.5 ms of their animation (`progress_phase_ms`), still drawn again every refresh: the frames that turn only a ring are no change a step waits on. A large indicator labelled Sincronizando spins all along, in its colour (#d03030): a progress indicator, busy. Bloom's Guardar button, pressed from the keyboard, works until its request is answered: its spinner over its hidden label, in the label's colour, the button busy, the keyboard staying on it, the status line said; then the result, said, the spinner gone. The reader's cursor, moved on from the button, says the status line, then the indicator: a progress indicator, busy. The button's work is a request to the scenario's server (`http`, sample/ProgressProbe.tsx), answered once a step gives the cue `save-done`: the work ends when the scenario says, after the step that shows it (until_named "Guardando…"), never on a 2.5 s clock that a loaded machine's settling outran.

steps.name: The button, the status line and the indicator spinning: its ring in its colour, open where the held phase leaves it; the step settles while it turns
Space: the button works, its spinner over its hidden label, in the label's colour, the button busy; the status line said; the keyboard stays on it
Its work done (the server answers on the cue save-done): the result said, the spinner gone, the button no longer busy, the keyboard still on it
Ctrl+Alt+Right: the reader's cursor from the button on to the status line
on to the indicator: said as a progress indicator, busy
